title: Case Studies Allentown
description: A reusable case studies section with an introduction, optional labelled divider, article-selected carousel and optional header CTA group.

theme.description: CMS-selected presentation setting passed to the renderer.

sectionLabel.description: Optional label displayed before the case carousel with a decorative line.

selectionMode.description: Choose Manual to select published articles in display order, or Automatic to list published articles matching the filters.

caseSources.description: Manual selection only. Select one or more published articles in display order. Every carousel card is populated from the selected article.

contentType.description: Automatic selection only. Choose the article content type to list.

articleType.description: Automatic selection only. Optionally limit results to one article type.

ctas.description: Add zero, one or two header actions. Set each style to Primary, Secondary, Clear or Clear base.
